extracted.name: Magical Dressing
extracted.description: We're going to tell you the secret for this very good dressing. It's the brown sugar and lemon pepper. They perform alchemy with the other three ingredients: olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and lemon juice. Makes one cup.
instruction_lines: Whisk together oil, vinegar, lemon pepper, sugar, and lemon juice. Use a funnel to pour into a clean bottle with a tight fitting lid. Shake bottle before using and pour over favorite green salad.
